Featured content
First Edition of the Print Technology World Championships 2025 at the HEIDELBERG Home of Print
Young international print talent gathered at the Home of Print for the debut of the Print Technology World Championships 2025. Together with the Swiss Printing and Media Association, HEIDELBERG hosted this new competition, giving young professionals an international stage and continuing the tradition of the former WorldSkills. Discover how we support the next generation of print experts and celebrate their achievements.

×
Amstetten
Amstetten is located about 25 kilometers north of Ulm. The site is the competence center for the ready-to-assemble production of castings and one of the most modern foundries in Europe. Hundreds of tons of iron castings of the highest quality are produced every day.
In Amstetten there is a wide range of fascinating topics, e.g. pattern making, handling liquid iron at 1500°C, management, technology and quality, simulation, networking and IT.
More
×
Brandenburg
Located 75 kilometers southwest of Berlin, the Brandenburg production site specializes in the manufacture of mechanical parts for printing press construction. Founded in 1991, this site is certified to ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 and currently employs around 470 people.
More
×
Kiel
Located 90 kilometers north of Hamburg on the Baltic coast, Kiel is our development center for workflow systems and software.
Certified according to ISO 9001 and ISO 14001, the site employs currently 220 employees.
More
×
Ludwigsburg
Ludwigsburg is the site of Heidelberg Postpress DE GmbH and is located about 20 kilometers north of Stuttgart. Folding machines and mailing systems are produced here and customer training is offered. There is a department for research and development, marketing, sales and service, and a demo center.
More
×
Wiesloch-Walldorf
15 kilometers south of Heidelberg, Wiesloch-Walldorf is the location of the world's largest and most modern printing press factory. This is where our printing presses are produced, assembled, and shipped internationally. Mechanical small parts and electronics production as well as our research and development center are also located at the site.
Finance, human ressources, service, sales and marketing, are also centrally managed from here. In our Print Media Center, customers can see for themselves the productivity of our presses.
More
×
Weiden in der Oberpfalz
Weiden in der Oberpfalz is the site for the development, manufacture and sale of inline flexo printing presses and die cutters. The site is ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certified and is located 100 kilometers east of Nuremberg.
More
From apprenticeship to leadership: employee voices
Three brothers, one employer
“We identify 100% with the company and its products. The opportunities for personal development, social responsibility, and respectful interaction make HEIDELBERG special to us.”
Like father, like son
“Even after 40 years, I still enjoy working at HEIDELBERG. But what I find particularly great is to feel how enthusiastic my son is about his vocational training and the company. I'm also in contact with other parents whose children work at HEIDELBERG, and you hear the same thing everywhere. The kids just love it here.”
Apprenticeship as a IT specialist
"Doors always open up and eventually you realize where your strengths lie. Especially when you have been trained and are employed by a large company like HEIDELBERG".
Nina Koch
Dual Study Program - Business Informatics
"HEIDELBERG is known as a world market leader and an up-and-coming technology group, but the atmosphere is almost family-like, and that is a very big plus."
Nico Feil
Apprenticeship as media designer for digital & print media
"The training is very practical and well structured. In addition, you get to see the entire process from creation to the finished product."
Verena Gund
Trainee Program - Industrial Engineering and Management
"Why HEIDELBERG? Because of all the exciting projects the company offers in the industrial sector, such as printed electronics, e-mobility, and data-driven business models."
Felix Plomer
Apprenticeship industrial mechanic
"This workplace is characterized by an extremely varied daily routine - there hasn't been a day when I haven't learned something new."
Markus Lösch
Dual Study Program - Digital Media, Media Publishing & Design
"The willingness of HEIDELBERG's staff to support young people and transfer knowledge is very strong."
Nicola Ermer
Apprenticeship as a warehouse clerk
"Demographic change is exacerbating the shortage of skilled workers. That's why I think vocational training creates security and provides a solid foundation."
Samira Saleh
Trainee Program - Electrical Engineering
"While other, predominantly smaller companies focus exclusively on practical work in their vocational training programs, HEIDELBERG is committed to a balanced theoretical and practical approach."
Jennifer Twartz
Apprenticeship as media technician for printing
"At HEIDELBERG, you have the opportunity to explore all facets of the business and therefore get a better insight into the world of print media than you would in a regular print shop."
Hendrik den Ouden
Dual Study Program - Digital Media, Media Management & Communication
"I have fond memories of every practical phase of my studies. One of the highlights was my practical phase abroad at the American branch office in Atlanta..."
Franziska Hiesinger
Apprenticeship as a warehouse clerk
"Logistics training at HEIDELBERG takes place at all the headquarter's different warehouses, which are quite a few - and always in the real production system."
Jonas Benda
Dual Study Program - Industrial Engineering
"You learn to work independently without having to be afraid, because the vocational training department and the specialist departments are always there to help and advise students."
Nena Jiang
Apprenticeship industrial clerk
"Independence and responsibility play an important role at HEIDELBERG - for apprentices too."
Alisa Wieloch
Trainee Program - Mechanical Engineering
"The variety of projects and areas at HEIDELBERG offer plenty of scope to discover and develop your potential."
Dennis Rossmannek
Apprenticeship as a warehouse clerk
"HEIDELBERG is a big name in the region and its vocational training programm in particular is very well regarded, so my decision fell pretty quickly on HEIDELBERG."
Felix Dathe

Weiden in der Oberpfalz Heidelberg Web Carton Converting GmbH × Amstetten Amstetten is located about 25 kilometers north of Ulm. The site is the competence center for the ready-to-assemble production of castings and one of the most modern foundries in Europe. Hundreds of tons of iron castings of the highest quality are produced every day. In Amstetten there is a wide range of fascinating topics, e.g. pattern making, handling liquid iron at 1500°C, management, technology and quality, simulation, networking and IT. More × Brandenburg Located 75 kilometers southwest of Berlin, the Brandenburg production site specializes in the manufacture of mechanical parts for printing press construction. Founded in 1991, this site is certified to ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 and currently employs around 470 people. More × Kiel Located 90 kilometers north of Hamburg on the Baltic coast, Kiel is our development center for workflow systems and software. Certified according to ISO 9001 and ISO 14001, the site employs currently 220 employees. More × Ludwigsburg Ludwigsburg is the site of Heidelberg Postpress DE GmbH and is located about 20 kilometers north of Stuttgart. Folding machines and mailing systems are produced here and customer training is offered. There is a department for research and development, marketing, sales and service, and a demo center. More × Wiesloch-Walldorf 15 kilometers south of Heidelberg, Wiesloch-Walldorf is the location of the world's largest and most modern printing press factory. This is where our printing presses are produced, assembled, and shipped internationally. Mechanical small parts and electronics production as well as our research and development center are also located at the site. Finance, human ressources, service, sales and marketing, are also centrally managed from here. In our Print Media Center, customers can see for themselves the productivity of our presses. More × Weiden in der Oberpfalz Weiden in der Oberpfalz is the site for the development, manufacture and sale of inline flexo printing presses and die cutters. The site is ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certified and is located 100 kilometers east of Nuremberg.
